title: Kaderblick Analyse Player – docs.kaderblick.de

hero.heading: Kaderblick Analyse Player
hero.lead: Kaderblick Analyse Player is a standalone desktop application for reviewing and presenting prepared match scenes. It can play local files and supported online videos, open scenes from a segment file, adjust image filters during playback and save the complete workspace as a session.

body:
Official documentation and downloads · GitHub project

Open your first analysis

  1. 1
    Download and start the application
    Open the official project page, choose the package for your operating system and start the application.
  2. 2
    Open the recording
    Add a local video file. Load further videos if you want to compare or switch between several camera angles.
  3. 3
    Load the segment file
    Open the corresponding CSV segment file. Its prepared scenes appear in the scene list.
  4. 4
    Select a scene
    Choose an entry from the scene list to jump directly to its saved starting point.
  5. 5
    Choose a playback mode
    Use normal playback, Segment mode for playing the prepared sequence, or Single repeat for reviewing the same scene in a loop.

Work with videos

  • Local videos: open recordings stored on your computer. Several videos can remain loaded for different perspectives.
  • Online video: opens a supported YouTube or Vimeo address inside the application.
  • Zoom: enlarges a selected area when a situation needs closer inspection.

Work with scenes

  • Scene list: contains the loaded segments. Selecting one moves playback to its defined start.
  • Segment mode: plays the scenes in list order without requiring each scene to be started manually.
  • Single repeat: repeats the selected scene until you leave the mode or choose another scene.
  • Segment editor: creates scenes with a start time, duration, title and the other fields offered by the editor, or updates existing entries.

Adjust the picture during analysis

Live filters alter the displayed picture while the video is playing. Change only the controls that help with the current scene and check the result directly in the player. Save frequently used combinations as a preset so that you can apply them again without rebuilding the settings.

Save and restore a session

A session stores the current workspace. Export it when the loaded videos, scenes, filters and view need to be continued later or transferred to another computer. Use Import session to restore that workspace.

Connection to Kaderblick

The scenes may originate from a segment file prepared for a match or from the match’s video section in Kaderblick. Kaderblick Analyse Player is then used for focused playback and presentation outside the browser.
